channelMetadataRenderer.description:
Black Metal! At the request of bands or labels I premiere albums and sometimes tracks. All official links are in the description of the videos. No politics!

NONE OF THE UPLOADS ARE MONETIZED BY BMP!!! The uploads that are monetized are monetized by digital distributors on behalf of the copyright owners.
 
All BMP-videos have the best possible sound quality! 

Also join BMP II: https://www.youtube.com/blackmetalpromotion2
https://linktr.ee/blackmetalpromotion

Contact (BANDS & LABELS ONLY!!!)
Send a DM via the BMP Facebook page, Instagram page, or send an email to b m p r e q u e s t at h o t m a i l dot c o m

FAQ (BANDS & LABELS ONLY!!!)
Q: I have an upload request, what do you need from me?
A: https://youtu.be/NzCjGn5A3z4

You can address me in English, German (will answer in English) or Dutch.
